<STBG 3,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><BGM 0,0,502><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
I found a butterfly I've never seen,
so I came to report it!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CV 3,2>Eliza!
Good of you to come. Show me.

These wings are like mirrors...
but so small, the light would be...

No, wait.
Perhaps they move in swarms...

These small butterflies must gather
to form a concave mirror...
A 'sun on the ground', indeed.

A Mirror Butterfly, one might say.
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>We did it, Hunter!
A great discovery!
